body:
WHAT
Saving a connection or applying a saved profile while an engine is already running does not restart that engine. The app sends one `set_connection` frame; the engine rebuilds its provider (the object that talks to the model API) in place. The conversation, session id, task list and mode all continue. Only when no engine is running does the app spawn one, and the result tells the UI which happened.

WHY
Restarting the engine to change endpoint killed the whole conversation, so trying another provider mid-task cost the session.

WHERE
app/main.js — applyValidatedConnection(workspace, validated, visionSelection): if tabForWorkspace(workspace) has a live child with writable stdin it calls writeToEngine({ type: "set_connection", connection: {...} }, tab.id) and returns { ok: true, live: true }, else startEngine() and { live: false }; "set_connection" is also in USER_ACTION_FRAMES so a dropped frame surfaces an error. engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — case "set_connection" → handleSetConnection(connection) mutates opts.settings and process.env, then rebuildProvider() (endpointSpecFromSettings + createProviderForEndpoint, then session.setProvider) and publishModelCatalog(); applySettingLive() routes CONNECTION_SETTING_KEYS (provider, baseUrl, apiKey, apiKeyEnv, allowInsecureTls) to the same rebuildProvider(), which is why SETTING_TIMING marks all five "session". app/renderer/modules/setup.js — markConnectionApplied(result) reads `live` to decide whether to wait for session_started.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a fake provider factory injected via EngineOptions.providerFactory, sending a set_connection frame mid-session calls the factory with the new baseUrl/apiKey and Session.setProvider receives the new provider, while the session id, message history and task list are unchanged (no session_started event emitted).
2. After set_connection with a non-empty apiKey, process.env[MAGENTRA_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY] equals the key, settings.apiKeyEnv is deleted and settings.apiKey is deleted; with an empty key all of MAGENTRA_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, DEEPINFRA_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are removed from process.env.
3. A set_connection frame without a `vision` object clears settings.visionConnection and sets settings.vision to false; one with vision.model set stores visionConnection and vision.enabled.
4. /settings baseUrl <url> (and provider, apiKey, apiKeyEnv, allowInsecureTls) reports the 'Applied to the current session.' note and triggers a provider rebuild; /settings model reports the next-turn note and does not rebuild.
5. In app/main.js, applyValidatedConnection returns { live: true } and writes a set_connection frame when the tab has a live child, and returns { live: false } and spawns when it does not; a set_connection frame written to a dead child produces the 'The engine is not running' error event.
